riddle: I'm a fried triangle with a crisp pastry coat, stuffed with spiced potato and peas, and I love a dip in green or tamarind chutney. What am I?
hint: The chai-time snack with three corners.

riddle: I'm piped in tangled orange spirals from fermented maida batter, fried till crisp, then dunked in sugar syrup. Hot mornings with rabri love me. What am I?
Subah subah mujhe ubaal ubaal ke banate ho, adrak aur elaichi daal ke, doodh aur patti ke saath. Cutting glass mein bhi milti hoon. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a hollow, crisp ball the size of a big marble. The vendor pokes a hole in my top, fills me with potato and spicy-tangy water, and you must eat me in one bite before I burst. What am I?
hint: The vendor keeps count; you never do.

riddle: Log mujhe Bombay ka burger bolte hain. Pav ke andar aloo ka fried gola, saath mein sookhi lehsun chutney aur ek tali hui hari mirchi. Kaun hoon main?
We arrive together: soft buns toasted with a big lump of butter, and a mashed mix of vegetables cooked on a huge flat pan with a spice blend named after us. What are we?
hint: Juhu beach stalls are famous for it.

riddle: I'm white, soft and round, steamed in a stand with many little cups. I'm made from fermented rice and urad batter, and sambar and coconut chutney are my best friends. What am I?
hint: A South Indian breakfast with no oil at all.

riddle: Tawa pe patla patla phailaya jaata hoon, crispy ban ke roll ho jaata hoon. Andar aloo masala bhar do toh mere naam ke aage 'masala' lag jaata hai. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Sambar aur chutney ke saath aata hai.

riddle: I'm sun-dried until I'm round and stiff as a page. Hold me over a naked flame and I blister and curl without ever melting, and though I'm the loudest thing at the lunch table, I have no voice at all. What am I?
Baarish shuru hote hi mummy besan ghol leti hai, pyaaz aur aloo dubo ke garam tel mein daal deti hai. Chai ke saath plate turant khaali. Kaun hoon main?
I'm churned yogurt, sweet or salty, served tall, thick and frothy with a layer of cream on top, often in a big steel or clay glass in Punjab. What am I?
hint: Amritsar does it best, some say.

riddle: I'm a brown ball of milk solids, deep-fried and soaked in rose-scented sugar syrup. At weddings I'm often served warm, sometimes with vanilla ice cream. What am I?
hint: Its name has a flower and a fruit in it.

riddle: Main safed hoon, spongy hoon, chhena se bana hoon. Chashni mein tairta hoon, aur dabao toh ras nikal jaata hai. Bengal aur Odisha dono mujhe apna bolte hain. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Tin ke dabbe mein bhi bikta hai.

riddle: I'm a messy Mumbai beach snack: puffed rice tossed with sev, onion, tomato and sweet and green chutneys, eaten fast from a paper cone before I go soggy. What am I?
hint: Chowpatty sells it by the thousand.

riddle: Aata goondha, belan se gol kiya, tawa pe senka aur seedha aag pe phulaaya. Ghar ke khaane mein roz milti hoon. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a flatbread layered with ghee, or stuffed with potato, radish or cauliflower. On a winter morning in Punjab I come with a big blob of white butter on top. What am I?
hint: Dhaba breakfast with curd and pickle.

riddle: Chawal ko chapta karke banaya jaata hoon. Pyaaz, mungfali, haldi aur kadi patta ke saath halka sa bhoona, upar se sev aur nimbu. Indore ka subah ka nashta. Kaun hoon main?
I'm milk boiled down for hours until thick, then frozen in a cone-shaped metal mould or a tiny clay pot. I melt slowly, taste of pista and kesar, and I'm sold on a stick from a cart. What am I?
hint: Denser than ice cream, never churned.

riddle: Garmiyon mein kachche aam kaat ke, masale aur sarson ke tel mein bhar ke, dhoop mein kaanch ki barni mein rakhte hain. Saal bhar khaane ke saath chatpata ban ke chalta hoon. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Naani ki recipe sabse secret hoti hai.

riddle: Milk goes to sleep overnight with a spoonful of me, and by morning it has become me. I cool your stomach and I'm the base of raita and lassi. What am I?
hint: It sets best in a warm kitchen.

riddle: I'm made by simmering butter until the milk solids turn brown and sink. I'm golden, I smell nutty, I set solid in winter, and a spoonful on hot dal-rice is pure comfort. What am I?
Main hara patta hoon, par khaane ke baad mujhe mod ke andar gulkand, saunf aur nariyal bhar ke khilaate hain. Banaras wala sabse mashhoor hai. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Shaadi ke khaane ke baad stall pe line lagti hai.

riddle: I'm cooked in layers: long-grain rice on top, marinated meat or vegetables below, the pot sealed with dough and slow-cooked. Hyderabad, Lucknow and Kolkata each claim the best version. What am I?
hint: Kolkata's version famously hides a potato.

riddle: Bimaar ho toh mummy yahi banati hai: chawal aur daal ek saath cooker mein, upar se thoda ghee. Simple hoon, par pet aur dil dono ko sukoon deti hoon. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a yellow, spongy square from Gujarat made of fermented gram flour batter, steamed, then topped with mustard seeds, curry leaves and a splash of sugary water. What am I?
Main gol hoon, meetha hoon, besan ya boondi se bana. Koi khushkhabri aaye, result aaye ya naukri lage, sabse pehle mujhe hi baanta jaata hai. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Mithai ki dukaan ka gol hero.

riddle: I'm a thin diamond-shaped sweet made from cashew paste and sugar, often wearing a shiny silver leaf. Festival gift boxes are full of me. What am I?
I'm chilled yogurt mixed with grated cucumber, onion or tiny fried gram flour pearls, sprinkled with roasted cumin. I sit beside biryani to calm the spice. What am I?
Garmi mein sabse sasta cooler: thanda paani, nimbu nichoda, cheeni aur thoda kaala namak. Railway station pe bhi milta hoon. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Khatta meetha namkeen, sab ek saath.

riddle: A roadside machine with iron rollers crushes long jointed stalks through it again and again, with a bit of ginger and lemon, and I pour out cold, sweet and frothy. What am I?
hint: The machine has ghungroos that jingle.

riddle: Baarish mein road ke kinaare koyle pe senka jaata hoon, phir aadha nimbu namak-mirch mein daba ke mujh pe ragadte hain. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a little steamed parcel from the hills that took over every Indian street corner. Steamed or fried, stuffed with veg or chicken, served with a fiery red chutney and clear soup. What am I?
hint: Delhi eats them by the plateful.

riddle: Do minute ka vaada karti hoon par kabhi nahi nibhaati. Hostel ki raaton ki saathi, peela packet, andar masala sachet. Kaun hoon main?
I'm bread that went into the oven a second time and came out a brick. I'm brave in the dry air, but the moment I dive into a hot brown lake, half of me gives up and sinks to the bottom. What am I?
hint: Count to three before you pull it out.

riddle: Hum jodi mein aate hain: ek phoola hua, maida ka bada fried gubbara, aur doosra masaledaar chhole. Delhi ka Sunday brunch. Kaun hain hum?
hint: Pyaaz aur achaar ke saath aata hai.

riddle: I'm a mashed potato patty shallow-fried on a big flat pan until crusty, then drowned in curd, tamarind and green chutney with a sprinkle of sev. What am I?
Main gol hoon, phooli hoon, khasta hoon. Andar moong daal ya pyaaz ka masala bhara hai, aur Rajasthan mein subah log mere liye line lagaate hain. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Aloo sabzi ke saath bhi aati hai.

riddle: I'm a tall dessert drink: rose syrup, chilled milk, soft vermicelli strands and swollen basil seeds that look like tiny frog eggs, crowned with a scoop of kulfi or ice cream. What am I?
hint: You need both a spoon and a straw.

riddle: Thele wala meri choti si topi chaaku se udaata hai, straw daalta hai, aur khatam hone pe andar ki malai bhi khurach ke deta hai. Kaun hoon main?
I drip slowly through a two-tier steel contraption, get mixed with boiling milk and sugar, and am poured back and forth between a tumbler and a little bowl to make me frothy. What am I?
I'm a knobbly root dried and ground into a golden powder. I stain your fingers yellow, I go into almost every dal, and grandmothers stir me into hot milk for a cough. What am I?
Hari hoon, patli hoon, lambi hoon, par gussa bahut hai. Kaato toh aankhon mein jalan, khaao toh muh mein aag. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Vada pav ke saath tali hui milti hai.

riddle: I'm a flat, heavy iron disc that sits on the stove all day. Rotis puff up on me, dosas spread across me, and nobody should ever scrub me with soap. What am I?

I'm a sealed steel pot with a rubber ring hiding in my lid and a weight sitting on top. Rajma and chole that took hours now take minutes, and if my safety valve blows, the dal ends up on the ceiling. What am I?
Main lambi si lakdi ki chhadi hoon, beech mein thodi moti. Aate ki loi ko gol roti banata hoon, aur purani filmon mein gusse wali biwi mujhe hathiyaar bana leti hai. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a deep, round-bottomed iron pan with two ear-like handles. Pakoras and puris are fried in my belly, and a famous paneer and chicken dish is named after me. What am I?
hint: Its name also appears on restaurant menus.

riddle: Gol steel ka dibba hoon. Andar saat chhoti katoriyan hain: haldi, mirch, jeera, rai, dhaniya, garam masala aur methi, saath mein ek chhota sa chammach. Mummy bina dekhe haath daal ke sahi masala nikaal leti hai. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a little mesh cup with a handle. I stand guard over every cup of chai, catching the tea leaves and ginger bits, and I'm permanently stained brown. What am I?
hint: Tapped on the pot rim after use.

riddle: Hum do patthar hain: ek chapta aur bada, doosra lamba aur chikna jo uspe aage peeche chalta hai. Mixie aane se pehle naani hum pe chutney aur masala peesti thi. Kaun hain hum?
I have two long arms joined at the shoulder and no hands. I pull hot rotis straight off the flame, and fitted with little metal rings I jingle along to Punjabi folk songs. What am I?

I'm a round-bellied pot of baked earth with a wide mouth and no long neck, sitting in a corner with a plate for a lid. Without electricity I keep drinking water cool in summer by sweating through my skin. What am I?
I'm a tall red steel bottle that hides under the kitchen counter. When I run out halfway through cooking it's a family emergency, and a delivery man carries me in on his shoulder. What am I?
hint: Booked by phone, awaited like a guest.

riddle: Mitti se paida hua, aag mein pakka, sirf ek baar garam meethi cheez se bhara gaya, phir tukdon mein wapas mitti mein mil gaya. Railway station pe kabhi hum hazaaron the. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Isme chai ka swaad alag hi hota hai.

riddle: I'm a stack of three or four round steel boxes clipped together with a carry handle. Dal goes at the bottom, sabzi in the middle, rotis on top, and off I go to school or office. What am I?
I'm a small lamp of baked clay with a cotton wick soaking in oil. On Diwali night I'm lined up in rows along balconies, windows and doorsteps. What am I?
Holi pe main bachchon ki paani wali bandook hoon. Rang wala paani bhar ke dost ke peeche daudo aur seedha nishaana lagao. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a soft dry powder in pink, green and yellow. On one spring festival people smear me on each other's cheeks, and I turn the air, the clothes and the whole street into a rainbow cloud. What am I?
Makar Sankranti pe aasmaan mein udti hoon, dor se bandhi. Koi kaat de toh chhat se 'kaai po che' ya 'bo kaata' ki awaaz aati hai. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a string coated with glue and powdered glass, sharp enough to cut fingers. My whole purpose is to slice through rivals high up in the January sky. What am I?
hint: Rolled on a firki before the battle.

riddle: Diwali ya Pongal pe darwaaze ke aage mujhe rang-birange powder ya chawal ke aate se banaya jaata hai. Main zameen pe bana ek sundar design hoon. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Ungliyon se dheere dheere banti hai.

riddle: I'm a decorated thread tied on a brother's wrist by his sister once a year, and in return she expects a gift or some cash. What am I?
Main patli lohe ki taar hoon. Jalao toh chingaariyan barsaati hoon par dhamaka nahi karti. Bachche mujhse hawa mein apna naam likhte hain. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a firecracker shaped like a little cone. Light my tip and I don't bang; instead I throw up a roaring shower of golden sparks. My Hindi name is also the name of a red, seedy fruit. What am I?
hint: Placed on the ground, never held.

riddle: Hari paste ban ke haathon pe design mein lagaayi jaati hoon. Sookh ke utaro toh laal-bhoora rang chhod jaati hoon. Kehte hain jitna gehra rang, utna pyaar. Kaun hoon main?
We come in pairs: short, decorated wooden sticks. During nine autumn nights of dancing in Gujarat, we clack against other pairs as dancers spin in circles. What are we?
I'm flat rubber footwear with a strap between the toes. I slap loudly as you walk, and Indian mothers can throw me with deadly aim. What am I?
hint: Also a remote-controlled missile at home.

riddle: Chaar lakdi ke paaye, beech mein rassi ya niwaar buni hui. Garmi ki raat mein aangan ya chhat pe bichha ke so jaate the. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Dhabe ke bahar bhi milti hai.

riddle: I'm a long light scarf worn with a salwar kameez, draped over the shoulders. I keep slipping off, getting caught in doors and dipping into the dal when you lean over the table. What am I?
hint: Pinned on one shoulder to behave.

riddle: Main seenkon ka guccha hoon, jhuk ke chalaaya jaata hoon. Subah subah poora ghar mujhse saaf hota hai, aur gusse mein mummy mujhe bhi utha leti hai. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a heavy cotton-stuffed winter cover. On cold mornings you curl up inside me, and a parent yanking me off you feels like the cruellest act in the world. What am I?
I hang from the ceiling and spin my three arms all summer. My regulator goes from one to five, and nobody ever dusts the tops of my blades. What am I?
hint: Switch me off and everyone complains.

riddle: Main chhe gaz ki hoon, bina silaai ke, blouse aur petticoat ke saath lapet ke pehni jaati hoon. Pallu mera sabse stylish hissa hai. Kaun hoon main?
Mummy ne mujhe plastic cover mein pack karke rakha hai taaki kharaab na hoon. Ghar mein mere liye ladai hoti hai, aur main hamesha sofa ke gaddon mein kho jaata hoon. Kaun hoon main?
I'm a tall steel storage box with doors and a secret locker inside that only one small key opens. Wedding saris, gold and property papers sleep in me, and my hinges creak loudly. What am I?
hint: The key usually hangs on a bunch at the waist.

riddle: Bijli jaate hi main jaag jaata hoon. Mera saathi ek bhaari dabba hai jismein distilled paani daalna padta hai, bhookh lage toh beep karta hoon, aur pankha chala sakta hoon par AC nahi. Kaun hoon main?
Raat ko palang ke upar chaaron kone baandh ke latkaayi jaati hoon. Meri jaaldaar deewaron ke andar tum chain se sote ho, aur bahar machchhar gaana gaate reh jaate hain. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Chhed ho jaye toh kaam khatam.

riddle: I'm a green spiral that burns slowly all night on a little metal stand, leaving a thin trail of smoke and a perfect ring of ash by morning. Buzzing pests hate me. What am I?
hint: Two spirals come stuck together; break carefully.

riddle: I'm a long, loose, collarless shirt reaching the knees, worn with pyjama, churidar or jeans. Every Indian man owns at least one white version for festivals. What am I?
I'm a small dot, red or velvet black, sometimes with a sparkle. I sit between the eyebrows, and when I fall off I'm found stuck on bathroom mirrors. What am I?
hint: Sold in sheets of many sizes.

riddle: I arrive folded before sunrise and I'm old news by lunch. Then I spend my second life lining shelves and wrapping hot bhajiyas, until I'm weighed and sold by the kilo at month-end. What am I?
hint: Delivered by a boy on a cycle.

riddle: Garmi ki raaton mein sab yahan bistar lagaate the, Sankranti pe yahin se patang udti hai, kapde yahin sukhte hain, aur paani ki tanki bhi yahin baithi hai. Ghar ka kaunsa hissa hoon main?
Main awaaz hoon, cheez nahi. Rasoi se aati hoon, aur mummy mujhe gin ke batati hai ki daal pak gayi ya nahi. Kya hoon main?
hint: Teen baar aayi toh gas band.

riddle: Main gol hoon aur teen chhote pairon pe khada hoon. Main kabhi kuch pakaata nahi, par ghar ki koi roti mere bina nahi banti, kyunki mera jodidaar roz mere chehre pe ludhakta hai. Kaun hoon main?
Teen pahiye, peela-hara ya kaala-peela rang. Meter se chalne ko bolo toh jawaab milta hai 'nahi bhaiya, itna lagega'. Kaun hoon main?
I'm Mumbai's lifeline: I run from before dawn till past midnight, people squeeze in shoulder to shoulder, and 'Virar fast' at rush hour is a phrase that strikes fear. What am I?
hint: First class, second class, ladies compartment.

riddle: Teen pahiye hain par petrol nahi peeta. Aage ek bhaiya pedal maarta hai, peeche do sawaari baithti hai, aur chadhaai aaye toh utarna padta hai. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Purani Dilli ki galiyon mein aaj bhi.

riddle: I have two big wooden wheels and no engine. Two horned animals pull me slowly down village roads, loaded high with hay or sugarcane. What am I?
I'm a lump that lies across the road and never moves, yet I make every vehicle bow. Unpainted, I'm a nasty surprise; painted, I'm still a pain in the back. What am I?
I'm made of willow, flat on one face and ridged on the back, with a rubber grip on my handle. Fans queue up to get star players to sign me. What am I?
hint: Knock it in with linseed oil first.

riddle: Gully cricket mein asli leather ball mehngi hai, isliye main aata hoon, upar se electrical tape lapet ke. Padosi ki khidki mera sabse bada dushman hai. Kaun hoon main?
We are three wooden sticks standing in a row with two tiny pieces balanced on our heads. In gully games, a pile of bricks or a school bag plays our role. What are we?
I stand behind the stumps at the bowler's end, count six balls on my fingers, and my raised index finger can break a batsman's heart. Who am I?
hint: Wears a hat and holds sweaters.

riddle: When the ball clears the rope without bouncing, the umpire raises both arms and the crowd screams. Commentators love calling me 'the maximum'. What am I?
We're two small pieces of wood, the lightest things on the field, yet a bowler hasn't bowled you out until at least one of us falls. What are we?
hint: They sit on top of three friends.

riddle: I'm the 22-yard strip in the middle of the ground. Groundsmen roll and water me, captains poke me before the toss, and commentators blame me when batsmen collapse. What am I?
hint: Green or dusty, it changes the game.

riddle: Bowler lagaataar teen ball pe teen wicket le le toh usko yeh milta hai. Football mein bhi teen gol maaro toh yahi naam. Kya hai yeh?
hint: Cricket aur football dono mein milta hai.

riddle: Batsman bina ek bhi run banaye out ho jaaye toh commentator mera naam leta hai, aur TV screen pe mera cartoon rote hue pavilion ki taraf chalta hai. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Batsman ke liye sabse sharmnaak score.

riddle: I'm a square wooden board with four net pockets in the corners. You flick a heavy disc with your finger at black and white pieces, and the red queen must be covered. What am I?
Road trip ho ya shaadi ki mehfil, log do team bana lete hain. Pichle gaane ka aakhri akshar pakdo aur usi akshar se naya gaana shuru karo. Kaunsa khel hoon main?
Kaanch ke chhote chhote gol daane, andar rang ki lehar. Mitti mein chhota gadda khod ke, ungli se nishaana laga ke jeete the. Kaun hain hum?
Two sticks make this game: a long one to strike with and a short one pointed at both ends. Tap the small one so it leaps into the air, then whack it far across the field. What game is this?
Saat chapte patthar ek ke upar ek jamao, ball maar ke gira do, phir tumhari team unhe wapas jamaane bhaagti hai jabki doosri team usi ball se tumhe nishaana banati hai. Kaunsa khel?
hint: Galiyon ka khel, patthar aur ball.

riddle: I'm a tiny roadside stall with a kettle always on the boil, glasses in a wire holder and jars of biscuits. Office gossip and career plans are made standing next to me. What am I?
Baraf ka choora dande pe daba ke gol shape dete hain, phir upar se rang-birange meethe sharbat daalte hain. Khaate khaate zubaan laal-neeli ho jaati hai. Kaun hoon main?
My Hindi name says I'm an old woman's hair. I'm pink and fluffy, spun from sugar inside a whirling drum, and I vanish the moment I touch your tongue. What am I?
Gali mein awaaz lagaata hoon: 'raddi, purana loha, plastic!' Tumhare purane akhbaar aur bottle tol ke le jaata hoon, aur mera taraazu sabko thoda shakki lagta hai. Kaun hoon main?
hint: Mahine ke end mein aata hai.

riddle: I stand behind a street-corner table with a heavy iron heated by glowing charcoal, and I hand back your clothes crisp and folded for a few rupees each. Who am I?
hint: Ask for starch on the collar.

riddle: Dulha ghodi pe, aage band-baaja, aur beech sadak pe chachaji naagin dance kar rahe hain. Poora traffic jam. Is naachte gaate juloos ko kya kehte hain?

Before mobiles, I was a glass-doored cabin on the street corner. A red digital meter ticked up your bill as you talked, and families queued outside me after 11 pm, when calls to other cities got cheaper. What am I?

I'm a spiral pressed out of a star-shaped nozzle straight into hot oil, savoury and ridged all around. In the south I go by one name, in Maharashtra another, and festive snack tins feel incomplete without me. What am I?
I stink so strongly that I'm kept in a tightly shut tin, yet a pinch of me in hot oil makes dal smell wonderful and calms a gassy stomach. I'm a dried resin, not a seed or a leaf. What am I?
hint: A tiny pinch is always enough.

riddle: I'm a fruit turned into leather: golden pulp spread thin on plates, sun-dried layer after layer, then cut into chewy sweet-sour strips sold in little packets. What am I?

We carry lunch, not letters. Thousands of us cross one huge city by train and cycle every day, reading coloured codes painted on lids, and business schools study how we almost never deliver to the wrong desk. Who are we?
I eat grain and give back snow. I roar all day in a small shop at the corner of the lane, you bring me wheat in a steel drum, and everyone who visits leaves with white eyebrows. What am I?
hint: Its dust is what rotis are made of.

riddle: I arrive without knocking, usually in the last over of a big match or on the hottest afternoon. Every fan in the colony falls silent at once, and when I finally leave, the whole street cheers together. What am I?
I'm sugarcane's rough brown child, boiled down in giant open pans and set into hard lumps. I'm not refined like my white cousin, and a small piece after a meal is an old habit. What am I?
hint: Winter sweets like chikki need it.

riddle: I dance at Rajasthani fairs but have no muscles or bones. My painted wooden face never changes expression, my skirt twirls, and every step I take is decided by someone hidden above the little stage. What am I?
hint: A folk show, not a film.

riddle: Kitty parties love me: a caller pulls numbers from a bag, everyone strikes digits off a printed paper ticket, and prizes go to the quickest five, each line, and the whole card. What game am I?
hint: Numbers called out, tickets struck off.

riddle: Before cable, I was the only channel in most homes. My logo spun slowly to a haunting tune, and someone always had to climb onto the roof and turn the antenna while the family shouted 'aaya? aaya?'. What am I?
hint: The name means seeing from afar.

riddle: Main koi ek masala nahi, kai masalon ki ek minute ki party hoon: garam ghee mein sab chatakte hain, phir main daal pe gir ke 'chhann' karta hoon aur poora ghar mehka deta hoon. Main dish nahi, par mere bina daal adhoori hai. Kaun hoon main?
Chawal aur doodh ko dheemi aanch pe ghanton hilaaya, saabut chawal ekdum naram, phir elaichi, kesar aur meve. Thanda karke bhi kha sakte ho. Kaun hoon main?
Main donut jaisa hoon, beech mein chhed, urad daal ka bana, bahar se crispy aur andar se naram. Sambar mein doob jaaun toh aur maza. Kaun hoon main?

I'm the sweet that travels: flaky threads of gram flour, sugar and ghee packed in a square cardboard box, passed from house to house every festival season, sometimes all the way back to the giver. What am I?
hint: Melts like wool in the mouth.

riddle: I'm a South Indian breakfast of roasted semolina stirred into boiling water with mustard seeds, curry leaves and chopped vegetables. Some people hate me; some secretly love me. What am I?
I'm a fast, air-conditioned train that runs through tunnels under the city and on tracks raised on pillars above it. A calm recorded voice tells you which side the doors will open. What am I?
hint: Tap your card at the gate.
